pack_contents: 'Ace Tone Rhythm Ace' top level has 16 mono 16-bit/44.1k one-shots with generic names and no metadata: KICK1-3, SNARE1-3, HHCL, HHOP, CLAVE, PERC1-PERC7. Sub-folder 'Acetone Rhythm Ace' has 12 named mono one-shots with 'smpl' chunks: RA Cl Hat, Clave, Cowbell, Cymbal, Guiro, Hi Bongo, Kick, Lo Bongo, Lo Conga, Maracas, Rim (only 9 ms long), Snare. Sub-folder 'Rhythm_Ace_loops' has 12 mono loops, Rhythm Ace LP1-LP12 (1.83-7.31 s), with no rhythm names. 'Rhythm-Ace' has 16 stereo, peak-normalized copies of the top-level 16 with 10 ms of tail silence added (waveform correlation >=0.999): KICK1-3 -> Bassdrum-01..03, SNARE1-3 -> Snaredrum-01..03, HHCL -> Hat Closed, HHOP -> Hat Open, CLAVE -> Clave, PERC1 -> Tom H, PERC2 -> Tom L, PERC3-6 -> Percussion-01..04, PERC7 -> Click. The hi-hat/rim/conga/guiro/bongo names don't match any FR-1 source, so the sampled unit is probably a later Rhythm Ace model (inferred); the exact model is unknown.

No loops.
